text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, on the way back from an outing...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Surprise for Trainer☆
Commencing Operation Heart-Pounding☆Falco's Repayment of Kindness☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Remember, remember! Trainer-san,
you helped Falco study for her tests before, right?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I've always wanted to thank you for back then! ☆
choice_data_list: Something like that is no big deal.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
No, no! A true Umadol always gives back
all the support she receives! â

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So, I'll tag along wherever
you want to go right now, Trainer☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since she offered,
I decided to accept Smart Falcon's kindness.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was a race I really wanted to see,
so I came to the racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, even before entering the racetrack,
it gets so exciting, doesn't it? ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Let's grab the best seats♪
Trainer, hurry, hurry☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
We've got great seats secured,
so Falco's gonna go grab some snacks! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: If I wanna cheer super loud, I gotta eat a hearty meal☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yakisoba, fried chicken, kushikatsu, imagawayaki,
soft-serve ice cream... I can't decide, they all look so good!♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Since we're here, I'll just buy all of them☆
Let's share nicely, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOAAAHH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Go-o-o, let's go, let's go-o-o!!
Do your best-t-t!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Just a little more...!
Whoaaa...!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Did you see that, Trainer?!
That final spurt just before the finish line earlier!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, huh? It feels like
I'm the only one getting all hyped up here...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Even though I came all the way here
intending to thank you, Trainer...
choice_data_list: It's fine, I'm having fun too!
It's fine, I'm having fun too!
As long as Falco's having fun, I'm satisfied
As long as Falco's having fun, I'm satisfied!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Even though I came all the way here
intending to thank you, Trainer...
choice_data_list: It's fine, I'm having fun too!
It's fine, I'm having fun too!
As long as Falco's having fun, I'm satisfied
As long as Falco's having fun, I'm satisfied!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Huh, really!?
If you say so, then Operation Repay the Favor is a huge success☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "Falco gets all smiley and happy seeing Trainer's smile too♪"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, let's let loose and go all out☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: L-O-V-E～☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Live races and live concerts really are the absolute best☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two of us fully enjoyed
an entire day at the racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~!? But then it really wouldn't
count as thanking you at all~!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... All I want is to put the person in front of me
first and make them happy, but...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
If I'm making people worry about me, 
the road to becoming a top Umadol is gonna be rough~.
choice_data_list: Just the thought is more than enough.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Gotcha☆ Then Falco is gonna
hype things up with everything she's got☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Just like getting the crowd hyped at a live show,
I'm gonna tune right into your feelings, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, thanks to Smart Falcon,
it turned out to be an even more special day than usual.
